issue_1_sky_view_factor_integration.method: Discrete 360° azimuthal integration with elevation angles clamped >= 0° for horizontal sensor plate

issue_2_numerical_reconciliation.resolution_statement: The crude theoretical upper bound (39.29 W/m²) assumes physically impossible simultaneous 800 W/m² direct solar illumination on all 360° terrain facets and fresh snow. Realistic peak is ~13 W/m² (rare spring snow hours) and annual daytime mean is ~3 W/m².

physical_distinction_vs_redundancy.physical_mechanism: Physically distinct (Stage 7.5 is subtractive direct/sky blocking; reflection is additive terrain scattering)
physical_distinction_vs_redundancy.information_redundancy: Redundant for GBT models because required parameters (horizon profile, solar geometry, snow state) are already fully present in Stage 7.5 and Stage 8.1.

final_classification: B. PHYSICALLY REAL BUT QUANTITATIVELY IMMATERIAL
